blocks.text: INQUIRER.net / Updated as of: 08:06 AM November 11, 2026

MANILA, Philippines — The defense team of Vice President Sara Duterte is set to present its third witness on Wednesday, corporate lawyer Suzette Balucanag-Punay, as the impeachment trial enters its 42nd day.

items: Balucanag-Punay, corporate counsel of GenCorp Industries Inc. and Metro City Chow Foods Corp, is expected to testify on the corporate records and financial statements of two companies linked to the vice president, which have figured in the prosecution’s allegations of undeclared wealth.
She is expected to present the General Information Sheets (GIS) and Audited Financial Statements of the two corporations linked to Duterte from 2022 to 2025.

After Balucanag-Punay’s testimony, the defense is expected to present representatives of nine banks where Duterte and her husband, lawyer Manases Carpio, maintain accounts.These include BDO Unibank, Bank of the Philippine Islands, EastWest Bank, Landbank of the Philippines, Metropolitan Bank & Trust Co., PSBank, Security Bank, UnionBank Davao and UnionBank Mandaluyong.

The prosecution has accused Duterte of having undisclosed wealth, citing her declaration in her Statement of Assets, Liabilities and Net Worth (SALN) that she was an incorporator of the two companies, despite not being listed in their GIS.
